items.title: Pakistan’s last-minute NOC demand hits NPL franchises hard
items.blurb: A sudden $25,000 fee requirement from the Pakistan Cricket Board forces NPL teams to scramble for emergency replacements, dampening global appeal and leaving fans disappointed.

items.title: Insurers have paid just 4 percent of Bhotekoshi flood claims
items.blurb: Payouts total Rs821.39 million against Rs20.9 billion in claims nearly two months after the disaster, with the final bill expected to rise.

items.title: Users turn to Nepal Telecom as private ISPs raise internet prices
items.blurb: The state-owned provider’s discounted annual 30 Mbps fibre package has drawn a surge of interest, but customers have raised concerns about delays, service quality and outdated routers.

items.title: Fresh signings deliver immediate results for NPL franchises amid late arrival and PCB-related chaos
items.blurb: From Hussain Talat’s match-winning bowling spell for Karnali to Chitwan’s airport-to-ground reinforcements, teams adapt swiftly to sudden changes.

items.title: Two-day weekend boosts tourism across hill stations
items.blurb: Introduced as an emergency measure to curb fuel consumption following the US-Israeli war on Iran, the new weekend policy has changed Nepalis’ travel habits and revitalised the country's hospitality sector.
